title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.9.22
subtitle: Smart Attach, lighter overlays and reliable Material Zone properties.

highlights.title: Smart Attach
highlights.description: Select source vertices, press Enter and click the target object. Each source binds to its nearest target surface vertex, including closed source loops.

highlights.title: Lighter Attachment overlays
highlights.description: Unchanged viewport redraws reuse anchor geometry and drawing batches. Edits and timeline changes refresh the preview.

highlights.title: Multiple Material Zone properties
highlights.description: Add distinct overrides repeatedly, including after removing a property. The add menu no longer repeats the previous action.
